recovery.confirmAck: I confirm this item should be hidden until restored.

impact.recording: The recording can no longer be played. Transcript, evaluations and statistics are kept.
impact.transcript: The transcript is hidden from the call page. Evaluations are kept.
impact.report: The report disappears from report history.

recovery.restoreBody: The item becomes available again exactly as before.
recovery.noPurge: Permanent deletion is not available here: it requires an approved retention policy and is performed by the backend with its own audit.

backups.title: Backup, restore and migration
backups.description: Backup configuration, manual backups, verification, the restore wizard, restore tests and migration readiness.
backups.syntheticTitle: Every backup and restore here is simulated
backups.syntheticBody: No data is copied, verified or restored, and no result on this page proves that a backup exists or works. The production backup service must perform and verify real backups.

errors.required: Database, QA/KPI results, scorecards, users, settings, audit history and secrets are always included.

settings.title: Backup configuration
settings.caption: Version v{v}. Each save creates a new version.
settings.encryption: Backups are always encrypted; secrets are only ever stored encrypted.
settings.scheduleHint: Scheduled backups run on the backend; the simulation never runs them.
settings.partial: Recordings or transcripts are excluded: a restore would not bring them back.

history.title: Backups
history.caption: Newest first. Run a manual backup or verify an existing one.

restores.title: Restore history
restores.caption: Test and full restores, newest first.

wizard.title: Restore from {id}
wizard.simulated: Simulated: no data will be read or changed.

modeHint.test: into an isolated area to prove the backup can be restored; live data is untouched.
modeHint.full: replaces live data with the backup contents.

wizard.verifyFirst: Verify this backup before a full restore.
wizard.typeId: Type the backup ID ({id}) to confirm
wizard.ackFull: I understand a full restore replaces live data and signs everyone out.

impact.test: The backup is restored into an isolated area and checked; users and live data are not affected.
impact.downtime: The application is put into maintenance mode; processing and ingestion pause during the restore.
impact.newerLost: Changes made after the backup was taken are replaced.
impact.users: Accounts, roles and MFA enrollments return to their backed-up state; everyone is signed out.
impact.secrets: PBX and email credentials are replaced with the backed-up (encrypted) values.
impact.audit: The audit history is restored and the restore itself is appended to it.

system.title: System health and operations
system.description: Services and API, CPU, RAM, GPU and disks, AI workers and queue, PBX ingestion, email delivery and the admin error log.
system.syntheticBody: Every figure is generated by the simulated backend. The production backend must collect real metrics; error messages are always sanitized (no credentials, one-time codes or recording content).

errors.title: Error log
errors.caption: Open: {critical} critical · {error} errors · {warning} warnings
errors.correlationHint: Use this ID to find related entries in the audit log.

general.title: General administration and branding
general.description: Application-wide defaults and runtime branding. Each save is a new version; earlier versions can be loaded back into the form.
general.syntheticBody: Settings are stored by the simulated backend in this browser. Branding stays a neutral placeholder until approved Taqeef assets are installed locally and configured here.

errors.email: Enter a valid email address or leave it empty.
errors.bothLanguages: Enter the text in both English and Arabic, or leave both empty.
errors.logoPath: Use a local asset path under /brand/ ending in .svg, .png or .webp.
errors.contrast: This colour does not reach the 4.5:1 contrast required for text.
errors.approval: Enter the reference of the branding approval.

app.title: Application settings
app.caption: Version v{v}.
app.defaultsHint: For users who have not chosen their own.
app.supportHint: Shown on error and sign-in pages. Optional.
app.weekStart: Reporting weeks run Saturday to Friday (approved rule).

branding.title: Branding
branding.caption: Version v{v}. Applied at runtime for every user.
branding.saved: Branding saved as v{v} and applied.
branding.noInvented: No company branding is included in this frontend; only approved assets installed locally may be referenced.
branding.logoHint: Path of a local, approved asset, e.g. /brand/logo-light.svg. Empty = placeholder.
